name: boxd Self-Host (Free Cluster)
free_limit: Run a self-managed boxd microVM cluster without a boxd license key, up to 16 total logical worker-host vCPUs across the cluster (not guest-VM vCPUs). Includes the console, API, DNS, SSH/HTTPS access, snapshots and automation.
watch_out: You must supply and pay for your own GCP/AWS instances, storage, networking, DNS, or bare-metal hosts; this is NOT free hosted compute. Above 16 total worker-host vCPUs, existing machines continue running but the cluster refuses new machines until capacity is reduced or a paid license key is installed. Installer code is Apache-2.0, but downloaded boxd binaries/images are separately licensed under PolyForm Internal Use with restrictions: personal use and a company's internal operations are permitted; redistribution is prohibited. Workers require KVM/nested virtualization; clusters send hourly usage telemetry.
